rationale: Complete the typed rejection-cause propagation required by D0 fail-closed customer communication. When reasoning produces no findings, the deterministic Decision and Safety Gate now preserves the already-governed request-level rejection kind from RequirementReasoningResult on DecisionGateOutput instead of dropping it during finding-only aggregation.
supersession_impact: No decision outcome, finding disposition, safety policy, response packet, or fail-closed behavior is replaced. The request-level typed cause is additive metadata for downstream communication; existing reasoning and decision traces remain unchanged.
authority_impact: No insurance authority is broadened. The change does not create findings, approve withheld content, or infer claim approval/payment. Exact-boundary waiting-period cases remain UNSUPPORTED_REASONING and fail closed; downstream layers may only explain the typed reason more accurately.
